item.title: A Little Known 1977 Srila Prabhupada Pastime
item.description: By Bhusaya dasa Lekhasravanti met with Prabhupada the next day and mentioned how her parents were both killed in a plane crash in 1970. Prabhupada immediately consoled her, quoting a Sanskrit verse that her parents were still alive somewhere, as the self (spirit soul) never dies. item.title: Putting An End to Courtesy Japa
item.description: By Mahatma Das “Nish, nish, ram, ram, nish, nish, ram, ram.” Prabhupada once imitated how we sometimes chant without focus, without concentration, without proper pronunciation – how we chant when we don’t feel like chanting. item.description: By Chandan Yatra DasSrila Gaura-Kisora dasa Babaji was a renunciation personified.
